The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e9a41553023f95e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Under the assumptions above, in particular l ≤ 1/2, define for each integer q ≥ 1 Uq(ρ, y) = ρ−q ∇q Mρ(y) (ρ > 0). These tensors extend smoothly to ρ = 0. There is an absolute constant C such that, for every 0 ≤ ρ < 1, y ∈ Rd and every split, |Uq(ρ, y)|split ≤ Cq qCq L( √ a)−(q−1) . (3.4) Here and below the vector-output slot is included among the tensor slots. The constant is uniform in the dimension, the primitive, its center and scale, and the derivative order q. Moreover, DMρ and U1 are symmetric, and ∇Hρ(y) = y + rρMρ(y), ∥∇2 Hρ∥op ≤ C. (3.5) For j ≥ 1, every split of ∇j∇2Hρ is bounded by Cj+1 (j + 1)C(j+1) ( √ a)−j . (3.6)
